newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LATE GOALS EARN ABERDEEN VICTORY OVER HEARTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE GOALS EARN ABERDEEN VICTORY OVER HEARTS.

text.p: Aberdeen leapfrogged over Glasgow Celtic into second place in the Scottish premier division by winning 2-1 away to Hearts on Wednesday.
Late goals from Duncan Shearer and Dean Windass handed Aberdeen the points after Colin Cameron had given the Edinburgh side the lead.

Aberdeen now have 28 points from 16 games, a point more than Celtic who have played two games fewer. Glasgow Rangers, beaten 1-0 at Dundee United on Tuesday, head the table with 35 points from 15 matches.
It was a miserable night for Edinburgh, with Hibernian losing 2-1 at Dunfermline, who scored through Marc Millar and Craig Ireland.
Celtic's home match against Kilmarnock was postponed because of international commitments.
